title: Package a browser game as an installable offline app
when: A finished browser game should install to the home screen, launch fullscreen in the right orientation, and play with no network, including levels, sprites and sounds.
prompt:
Goal: After the first visit the whole game, with every asset, loads and plays in airplane mode.
Steps:
1. manifest.webmanifest: name, short_name, start_url "./", scope "./", display "fullscreen", orientation, background_color, theme_color, icons 192 and 512 png plus a "maskable" one.
2. Link it in index.html with <link rel="manifest" href="manifest.webmanifest"> and a theme-color meta.
3. sw.js: const CACHE = "game-v3"; install runs cache.addAll(ASSETS) with html, js, css, levels, sprites and audio.
4. activate deletes every cache whose name is not CACHE, then calls clients.claim().
5. fetch answers cache first with network fallback; audio Range requests get the full cached response matched by URL.
6. main.js: if ("serviceWorker" in navigator) call navigator.serviceWorker.register("sw.js") in a load listener with a catch.
7. When a new worker waits, an "Update ready" button posts a message so the worker calls self.skipWaiting().
8. Saves stay in guarded localStorage; clearing site data deletes them, so say so in the options.
Quality bar:
- The devtools installability check passes and an offline reload works.
- Bumping CACHE ships new assets without a stale mix.
Pitfalls:
- An asset missing from the list, which breaks only offline.
- Absolute paths that fail when hosted in a subfolder.
- Huge music files slowing the first install; stay under about 20 MB.
Verify:
- [ ] An offline reload plays a full level with sound.
- [ ] Old caches are gone after an update.
Output: manifest.webmanifest, sw.js, icons/, updated index.html and main.js.

examples.input: quero instalar meu jogo no celular e jogar sem internet
examples.output: fullscreen manifest, versioned asset cache with audio, update prompt, guarded saves
